name: end_call
description: Closes the call session in an orderly way.
notes: This is always the last tool executed in any terminal flow.
Make sure all required updates have been completed before end_call.

name: time_now
description: Authorized tool for getting the real current date and time in the given timezone. Its response is the flow's only authorized time reference.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: when a node declares EXECUTE: time_now, call it as the first action of the turn — imperative, no exception.

ABSOLUTE EXECUTION RULE: FORBIDDEN to deduce, estimate, or assume the current date or time from the model's knowledge, training, or conversational context. Do not speak or route before capturing the 'now' field.
ARGUMENT RULE: iana_timezone is an IANA continent/city identifier (e.g. America/Bogota, Europe/Madrid, America/Sao_Paulo). Send whatever the flow fixes; never use abbreviations (EST, COT, BRT).
SOURCE OF TRUTH RULE: use the 'now' field as the only authorized time reference. To normalize a relative date ('8 months ago', 'last year'), compute it from 'now'.
POST-EXECUTION RULE: if 'now' comes back null or 'errors' is not null, call the tool again before continuing.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: IANA identifier of the timezone the current time is wanted in (continent/city). Examples: America/Bogota, Europe/Madrid, America/Sao_Paulo.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Boolean: the query ran successfully.

outputs.name: iana_timezone
outputs.description: Echo of the IANA timezone identifier used.

outputs.name: now
outputs.description: Current date and time in the given timezone, ISO 8601 with offset. Example: 2026-08-28T18:18:28.935329-05:00. null on error.

outputs.name: calendar
outputs.description: The next 21 days starting today in the given timezone, as 'YYYY-MM-DD Weekday' entries separated by commas (e.g. '2026-10-27 Tuesday, 2026-10-28 Wednesday'). Use it to resolve weekday names and relative days ('Wednesday', 'tomorrow') to a calendar date. null on error.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Error message if the query failed. null on success.

name: update_custom_field
description: Actualiza un campo personalizado (Custom Field de contacto) o un valor personalizado (Custom Value global) en GoHighLevel.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION: cuando el usuario pide cambiar una preferencia personalizada como su idioma, o una configuración global de la subcuenta.
ARGUMENTS: name (nombre legible como 'language' o ID técnico), value (nuevo valor).
CONTEXT RULE: provee contactId para cambios específicos del usuario; si se omite pero se da locationId, actualiza un valor global (Custom Value).
SOURCE OF TRUTH: usa success para confirmar que GHL aceptó el cambio.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Nombre o ID del campo/valor a actualizar. Ejemplo: 'language', 'uWLes...'.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Nuevo valor a asignar. Ejemplo: 'Spanish', 'English'.

inputs.name: contact_id
inputs.description: ID del contacto en GHL (disponible en context.contact_id). Si se provee, se actualiza su campo personalizado.

inputs.name: location_id
inputs.description: ID de la ubicación en GHL (disponible en context.location_id). Necesario para valores globales o para buscar campos por nombre.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Indica si la operación fue exitosa.

outputs.name: type
outputs.description: Indica qué se actualizó: 'contact' (campo de usuario) o 'custom_value' (global).

outputs.name: field_id
outputs.description: ID técnico del campo/valor actualizado.

outputs.name: field_name
outputs.description: Eco del nombre del campo solicitado.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: Eco del valor asignado.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Mensaje de error si la operación falló.

name: send_whatsapp_template
description: Envía a un contacto de GoHighLevel una plantilla de WhatsApp aprobada.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION: ejecútala cuando el flujo pida enviar una plantilla de WhatsApp al contacto (por ejemplo para retomar a quien no ha escrito en las últimas 24 horas). La plantilla la define el flujo con su nombre e idioma; nunca inventes un nombre.

ARGUMENTS: template_name y language (los que indica el flujo), contact_id y location_id (disponibles en el contexto del contacto). body_variables solo si la plantilla tiene variables: los valores en orden, o {{contact.first_name}} para el nombre del contacto, que GHL resuelve. from_number_id, to_number y category solo si el flujo los indica.

BEHAVIOUR: GHL identifica la plantilla por nombre e idioma, no por el ID numérico de su lista; el contacto recibe la plantilla aprobada (la herramienta rellena sola el texto que GHL exige). Fuera de las 24 horas de WhatsApp solo una plantilla llega al contacto.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: usa success para confirmar que GHL aceptó el mensaje; message_id y conversation_id identifican lo enviado. Si success es false, no digas que se envió.
SILENT ACTION: no le cuentes a la persona detalles técnicos del envío (IDs, plantilla, herramienta).

inputs.name: template_name
inputs.description: Nombre de la plantilla en GHL, tal como lo indica el flujo (ej. sam_fc_es).

inputs.name: language
inputs.description: Idioma de la plantilla tal como lo muestra GHL: es, en_US o pt_BR.

inputs.name: contact_id
inputs.description: ID del contacto en GHL (disponible en context.contact_id).

inputs.name: location_id
inputs.description: ID de la ubicación (subcuenta) del contacto en GHL (disponible en context.location_id). Elige el token de la subcuenta.

inputs.name: body_variables
inputs.description: Valores de las variables del cuerpo, en orden. Ejemplo: ['{{contact.first_name}}'].

inputs.name: category
inputs.description: Categoría de la plantilla: UTILITY (por defecto), MARKETING o AUTHENTICATION.

inputs.name: from_number_id
inputs.description: ID del número de WhatsApp remitente. Si falta, el predeterminado de la subcuenta.

inputs.name: to_number
inputs.description: Número de WhatsApp del contacto en formato internacional. Si falta, el que GHL tiene del contacto.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Indica si GHL aceptó el mensaje.

outputs.name: message_id
outputs.description: ID del mensaje que creó GHL.

outputs.name: conversation_id
outputs.description: ID de la conversación del contacto.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Mensaje de error si el envío falló.

name: add_tags
description: Agrega una o varias etiquetas (tags) a un contacto de GoHighLevel.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION: ejecútala cuando el flujo pida marcar al contacto con una etiqueta (por ejemplo al calificar, al agendar o al cerrar la conversación). Solo agrega etiquetas; nunca quita ninguna.
ARGUMENTS: tags (lista de nombres de etiqueta, tal como los define el flujo), contact_id y location_id (disponibles en el contexto del contacto).
BEHAVIOUR: GHL pasa las etiquetas a minúsculas, crea las que la subcuenta aún no tiene e ignora las que el contacto ya tiene, así que repetir la llamada es seguro.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: usa success para confirmar que GHL aceptó el cambio; tags_added dice cuáles se agregaron realmente (vacía si el contacto ya las tenía todas).
SILENT ACTION: nunca le digas a la persona que le estás agregando etiquetas.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: Etiquetas a agregar. Una lista de nombres. Ejemplo: ['calificada', 'cita_agendada'].

inputs.name: contact_id
inputs.description: ID del contacto en GHL (disponible en context.contact_id).

inputs.name: location_id
inputs.description: ID de la ubicación (subcuenta) del contacto en GHL (disponible en context.location_id). Elige el token de la subcuenta.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Indica si GHL aceptó la operación.

outputs.name: tags
outputs.description: Todas las etiquetas que tiene el contacto después de la operación.

outputs.name: tags_added
outputs.description: Las etiquetas que se agregaron en esta llamada (vacía si el contacto ya las tenía todas).

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Mensaje de error si la operación falló.

name: remove_tags
description: Quita una o varias etiquetas (tags) de un contacto de GoHighLevel.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION: ejecútala cuando el flujo pida quitarle una etiqueta al contacto (por ejemplo al pasar de una etapa a otra). Solo quita las etiquetas que nombra; las demás se conservan.
ARGUMENTS: tags (lista de nombres de etiqueta, tal como los define el flujo), contact_id y location_id (disponibles en el contexto del contacto).
BEHAVIOUR: GHL pasa las etiquetas a minúsculas antes de compararlas e ignora las que el contacto no tiene, así que pedir una que no está no es un error.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: usa success para confirmar que GHL aceptó el cambio; tags_removed dice cuáles se quitaron realmente (vacía si el contacto no tenía ninguna) y tags cuáles le quedan.
SILENT ACTION: nunca le digas a la persona que le estás quitando etiquetas.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: Etiquetas a quitar. Una lista de nombres. Ejemplo: ['contacted', 'nuevo'].

inputs.name: contact_id
inputs.description: ID del contacto en GHL (disponible en context.contact_id).

inputs.name: location_id
inputs.description: ID de la ubicación (subcuenta) del contacto en GHL (disponible en context.location_id). Elige el token de la subcuenta.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Indica si GHL aceptó la operación.

outputs.name: tags
outputs.description: Las etiquetas que le quedan al contacto después de la operación.

outputs.name: tags_removed
outputs.description: Las etiquetas que se quitaron en esta llamada (vacía si el contacto no tenía ninguna).

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Mensaje de error si la operación falló.

name: calculate_bmi
description: Authorized tool to calculate BMI. Its result is the source of truth for eligibility.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION: trigger upon entering the node that calculates the BMI.
ABSOLUTE RULE: do not calculate manually. Do not speak before capturing the BMI.
ARGUMENTS: weight_kg (kg), height_cm (cm). If captured in lbs/ft, convert before calling (1 lb = 0.4536 kg; 1 in = 2.54 cm).
SOURCE OF TRUTH: use the captured BMI only; do not recompute manually.

inputs.name: weight_kg
inputs.description: Candidate's current weight in kilograms.

inputs.name: height_cm
inputs.description: Candidate's current height in centimeters.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Execution status (bool).

outputs.name: imc
outputs.description: Decimal BMI value. null if inputs were invalid.

name: get_available_slots
description: Authorized availability tool; source of truth for days and times.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION: on entering the availability nodes (SC_AV*) or the re-check nodes (SC_CHK*) to re-verify the chosen time, and on any intent to schedule/reschedule/see-more/retry.
ABSOLUTE RULE: do not mention availability before executing the tool and capturing the available slots.
ARGUMENTS: calendar_type is required: the calendar key the flow indicates (e.g. 'FT'); iana_timezone is a real IANA zone (e.g. America/Bogota) resolved or fixed in the flow.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: use only available_slots; each slot must include start_co and start_local.

PRESENTATION: speak only with start_local; start_co is internal. A slot has no end; it lasts the fixed appointment duration of the calendar. When days is present, say the days, parts of the day and time blocks from days: it is a summary built by the tool from the same slots, and available_slots stays the source for booking.

inputs.name: calendar_type
inputs.description: The calendar to query, as indicated by the flow (e.g. 'FT'). Required: the tool fails without it.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: Real IANA identifier of the timezone the times are shown in (continent/city, or continent/country/city for zones that need it), as decided by the flow: asked to the contact or fixed by the agent. Never guessed, never shortened to two parts when the real identifier has three. Examples: America/Bogota, Europe/Madrid, America/New_York.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Boolean: the query ran correctly. It does not by itself indicate whether there is availability — check available_slots for that.

outputs.name: iana_timezone
outputs.description: Echo of the real IANA identifier (continent/city, or continent/country/city) used to compute start_local (and the days summary).

outputs.name: days
outputs.description: Summary of available_slots by day, soonest first. Each item has date (YYYY-MM-DD), label (English weekday, month and day, e.g. Friday, November 27), timezone (IANA zone) and utc_offset of that day, parts_of_day (morning, afternoon, evening or night, those with slots), times (typed blocks) and slot_count. A block is {type: continuous_range, first_start, last_start, every_minutes}: a bookable start time every every_minutes between first_start and last_start, both included; or {type: single_slot, start}: that is the only bookable start time of the block. Date, label, parts_of_day and times are all in the timezone of the contact, not of the company. Say days and times only from here; never invent a day.

outputs.name: available_slots
outputs.description: Array of objects with the available slots. Each object carries start_co (Colombia time, ISO 8601) and start_local (contact's zone, ISO 8601), the same instant, so book with the start_co of the slot whose start_local the contact chose. Empty array ([]) if there is no availability.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Error message if the query failed. null on success, even when available_slots came back empty.

name: book_appointment
description: Authorized booking tool. Creates the appointment from a valid slot.
notes: ARGUMENTS: calendar_type is REQUIRED: the calendar key the flow indicates (e.g. 'FT'). The tool fails without it.
MANDATORY EXECUTION: trigger on entering node SC__SC_BOOK.
ABSOLUTE RULE: do not confirm booking before success == true.
ARGUMENTS: start_date is copied literally from start_co of the chosen slot. iana_timezone is fixed to America/Bogota.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: use success to decide creation; confirm only with success == true and event_id != null.

inputs.name: calendar_type
inputs.description: Calendar to use, as indicated by the flow (e.g. 'FT'); the tool fails if it is missing.

inputs.name: start_date
inputs.description: Start date/time in ISO 8601 (start_co copy).

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Appointment duration in minutes. Fixed: <APPT_MIN>.

inputs.name: contact_name
inputs.description: Contact's full name; filled in by the platform when not passed.

inputs.name: contact_email
inputs.description: Contact's email; filled in by the platform when not passed.

inputs.name: contact_phone
inputs.description: Contact's phone (E.164); filled in by the platform when not passed.

inputs.name: contact_id
inputs.description: CRM contact the appointment belongs to: the conversation's contact_id, which the platform provides in the contact. The tool fails without it (reason missing_contact_id) and never looks a contact up by e-mail or phone.

inputs.name: iana_timezone
inputs.description: Identificador IANA de la zona horaria del contacto, valor fijo America/Bogota.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Booleano: la reserva se creó correctamente.

outputs.name: reason
outputs.description: Motivo del rechazo cuando success es false: 'invalid_start_date', 'past_date', 'invalid_hour', 'creation_failed', 'slot_taken'. null cuando success es true.

outputs.name: event_id
outputs.description: Identificador del evento creado. null si la reserva no se completó.

outputs.name: event_link
outputs.description: Link to the event in the calendar. null if the booking was not completed.

outputs.name: meet_link
outputs.description: Video call link for the appointment. null if the booking was not completed.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Technical error message. May be present with success == true if the appointment was created but email notification failed.

name: kb_answer
description: Authorized tool that answers an open question about the company and its services from the approved knowledge base. Its kb_answer output is the only source for the answer.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION: on entering KQ__KQ_ANSWER.
ARGUMENTS: question is the contact's question and language is the conversation language.
history is added by the runtime; the flow never sets it.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: use kb_found as the only verdict. When kb_found is false the knowledge base does not cover the question: never answer it from your own knowledge.

inputs.name: question
inputs.description: The contact's question, in their own words.

inputs.name: language
inputs.description: Language of the answer: the language of the conversation.

inputs.name: history
inputs.description: Recent conversation, filled in by the runtime (never by the flow). It lets a follow-up question such as 'and how long does it take?' be understood.

outputs.name: kb_answer
outputs.description: The answer written in the requested language. Empty when kb_found is false.

outputs.name: kb_found
outputs.description: Whether the knowledge base answered the question (true/false).

name: surrogate_classification
description: Authorized final classification tool for medical and demographic eligibility. Its response is the only authorized source to resolve if the candidate is approved, pre-approved (voice calls only), rejected or inconclusive.
notes: MANDATORY EXECUTION TRIGGER: execute this tool immediately upon reaching node Q__SQ_RUN_CLASSIFICATION — imperative, without exception — with all the data collected up to that point.
ARGUMENTS: send captured fields as-is; empty when missing. Do not invent values. bmi must be copied literally from calculate_bmi.
ARGUMENT RULE: city must be one of: Bogotá, Soacha, Zipaquirá, Chía, Mosquera, Funza, Cajicá, Madrid, La Calera, Cota, Facatativá, Sibaté, or 'Otro'. Any other city rejects the candidate by city.
ARGUMENT RULE: birth_type ('csection' or 'natural') is only required when the last birth was less than 18 months ago; otherwise it may be empty.

ARGUMENT RULE: voice is true only in a voice call and false (or empty) in every other channel. With voice true the document and the EPS are not evaluated at all (document_type and eps_active_affiliation are ignored even if they are sent: a voice agent does not send them) and the best verdict is Pre-approved. With voice false or empty the full classification runs.

ARGUMENT RULE: document_type is 'cedula_ciudadania', 'ppt' or 'other'. Only the first two are accepted. With voice false it may be empty (or an empty string): then the result is Inconclusive with not_eligibility_reason 'missing_data (document_type)'. A value that is not accepted is rejected by documentation.

ARGUMENT RULE: with voice false, eps_active_affiliation may be empty (or an empty string): then the result is Inconclusive with not_eligibility_reason 'missing_data (eps_active_affiliation)'. A 'no' is rejected by EPS.

EVALUATION ORDER: with voice false, document_type and eps_active_affiliation are the last data evaluated, in that order, so any other missing or failing data is reported first. With voice true the evaluation ends before them.
ARGUMENT RULE: abortions, preeclampsia, eps_active_affiliation, drug_use and availability accept 'si'/'no', 'yes'/'no', 'true'/'false' or '1'/'0', case-insensitive. So does voice.
SOURCE OF TRUTH RULE: use 'result' as the only authorized verdict. Nationality is recorded but never rejects. Do not replace this decision with agent heuristics.
POST-EXECUTION RULE: if 'result' is 'Inconclusive', request or reconfirm the missing data before calling the tool again.

POST-EXECUTION RULE: if 'result' starts with 'Rejected', communicate it with empathy and do not continue the qualification. If it is 'Approved' or 'Pre-approved', continue to the questions and scheduling step.

inputs.name: age
inputs.description: Candidate age in years. Numeric value when it exists.

inputs.name: city
inputs.description: Candidate city of residence in Colombia. Must be one of the allowed cities or Otro.

inputs.name: nationality
inputs.description: Nationality as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. Recorded only; never rejects.

inputs.name: number_of_children
inputs.description: Number of children born alive. Numeric value when it exists.

inputs.name: last_birth_date
inputs.description: Date of the last birth, YYYY-MM-DD (also accepts YYYY/MM/DD). Empty when it does not exist.

inputs.name: birth_type
inputs.description: Type of the last birth: csection or natural. Required only when the last birth was less than 18 months ago.

inputs.name: number_of_c_sections
inputs.description: Total number of C-sections. Use 0 when none.

inputs.name: abortions
inputs.description: Whether the candidate has had an abortion. Recorded only.

inputs.name: preeclampsia
inputs.description: Whether the candidate has a history of preeclampsia.

inputs.name: bmi
inputs.description: Body mass index calculated by calculate_bmi. Never estimated by hand.

inputs.name: document_type
inputs.description: Identity document: cedula_ciudadania, ppt or other. Empty when it was not captured (the result is then Inconclusive for this field).

inputs.name: eps_active_affiliation
inputs.description: Whether the candidate has an active EPS affiliation (from check_adres). Empty when it was not captured (the result is then Inconclusive for this field).

inputs.name: drug_use
inputs.description: Whether the candidate uses or has used psychoactive substances.

inputs.name: availability
inputs.description: Whether the candidate has time available to attend the medical appointments.

inputs.name: voice
inputs.description: Whether this is a voice call. True skips the document and EPS evaluation (they are ignored) and the best verdict is Pre-approved; false or empty runs the full classification.

outputs.name: success
outputs.description: Whether the classification was executed correctly.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Final classification: 'Approved', 'Pre-approved' (only with voice), 'Inconclusive', 'Rejected (Age)', 'Rejected (Timing)', 'Rejected (City)', 'Rejected (Children)', 'Rejected (C-Sections)', 'Rejected (Preeclampsia)', 'Rejected (BMI)', 'Rejected (Documentation)', 'Rejected (EPS)', 'Rejected (Drug Use)' or 'Rejected (Availability)'.

outputs.name: eligibility_result
outputs.description: Eligibility value for the GHL field: 'approved', 'pre-approved' (only with voice), 'rejected' or 'inconclusive'.

outputs.name: not_eligibility_reason
outputs.description: Reason for the GHL field: 'age', 'timing', 'city', 'children', 'c_sections', 'preeclampsia', 'bmi', 'documentation', 'eps', 'drug_use', 'availability' when rejected, 'missing_data (<field>)' with the first missing field (for example 'missing_data (document_type)') when inconclusive, 'none' when approved or pre-approved.

outputs.name: errors
outputs.description: Technical error message if classification failed. null in case of success.
